outline: This beginning-level ESP (English for specific purposes) course is designed to develop students’ essential English communication skills for the workplace. Through activities related to résumé writing, business communication, job interviews, briefings, and office conversations, students will receive integrated training in the four language skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The course will also strengthen their foundational language knowledge and skills, including vocabulary, grammar, and sentence construction.

flexible_learning.content:
1. Week 17: Students are required to watch an instructional video recorded by the instructor titled "Guide to Producing a Job-Seeking Self-Introduction Video." The content explains the key points for producing a job-oriented self-introduction video.

2. Week 18: Students are required to complete the production of a personal self-introduction video (5 minutes) as an MP4 file.
flexible_learning.outcome:
1. Week 17: Cross-check and record students' video viewing hours in the backend of NTUT's i-School PLUS platform, while simultaneously setting up a discussion board on Zuvio to guide interaction.

2. Week 18: Students submit their video MP4 file via the Padlet platform.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: Learning outcomes from the flexible week(s) account for 10% of the total grade.

assessment:
1. Continuous Assessment (attendance, participation, in-class exercises and quizzes): 30%
2. Course Midterm and Final Examinations: 30%
3. English Proficiency Test (Listening and Reading Assessment): 20%
4. Guided Writing: 10%
5. Presentation Video (Speaking):10%
